description: Converting a map is an error when an element doesn't convert to its optional attribute's type
notes: Not disputed like native/functions/function-error-is-eval-error: the README defines convert's result as the conversion, and the spec makes this conversion an error: a map converts to an object by converting each element to its attribute's type (spec.md#collection-and-structural-type-conversions), and a string doesn't convert to a list of strings. That the attribute is optional only allows the map to lack it.
reference_error: map element type is incompatible with attribute
